title: 14-jähriger E-Scooter-Fahrer flüchtet vor Verkehrskontrolle – Beamter setzt DEIG ein

extraction.summaryEn: During a traffic check in Köpenick, a 14-year-old e-scooter rider sped off and crashed, then fled on foot and was hit by a police taser (DEIG). He was treated by paramedics for a torso injury and released to his father.
